unchanged_professional_contract.fixture_pass_rule: both calibrated judges pass; conservative minimum for every dimension >= 1; zero hard fail

changed_only: candidate transport: openai-responses-api -> ChatGPT-authenticated Codex CLI ephemeral execution
judge transport: Gemini/OpenAI metered APIs -> two isolated ChatGPT-authenticated Codex CLI judge invocations
transport observability and technical retry classification
explicitly_unchanged: held-out fixture/references when integrity remains valid
fail-closed distinction between infrastructure failure and PROFESSIONAL_REVISE

independence.candidate: fresh ephemeral candidate workspace/process per fixture; frozen candidate plus only current visible task fields; no pack path, expected answer, grader reference, judge prompt, qualification key or release result
independence.filesystem_gate: candidate workspace must be readable while sealed-pack/grader/key roots are mechanically denied before any model call and cleanup is verified
independence.judge: fresh ephemeral process/workspace per judge call; judges are blind to each other and release outcome; no tools/filesystem/web/MCP
independence.same_family_limitation: candidate and judge-B may use the same model family; independence claim is process/context/filesystem separation, not provider-family independence
independence.ordering: all candidate responses are completed and persisted in evaluator-owned state before grader.json is loaded for hidden judging

calibration.source: public CAL cases already present in sealed_runner_template_v0_1.py
calibration.schema_rule: calibration response schema contains results only; pair_results exists and is required only in heldout mode

pre_run_budget_gate.next_unscored_gate_breakdown: 2 initial public judge calibration calls + at most 1 shared TRANSIENT_TRANSPORT retry + 1 exact candidate canary
pre_run_budget_gate.release_reserve: preserve capacity for 24 candidate fixture calls plus 2 isolated hidden judge batches after explicit authorization

gates: explicit evaluator review and scored authorization
sanitized release record and fail-closed verdict
migration_issue_stop_rule: Run zero-model deterministic/static checks only. If they pass, record MIGRATION_READY and stop before any Codex model invocation.
